title: Buccaneers to release Jake Browning; Jalon Daniels set to be No. 2 QB

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Buccaneers to release Jake Browning; Jalon Daniels set to be No. 2 QB
sources.description: The Buccaneers gave undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels a shot to win the backup quarterback job and he took full advantage of it.
